Shilu Zheng 郑诗璐, Associate Professor (she/her)

Shilu is an Associate Professor in the College of Environment and Ecology of Xiamen University. She was a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at Fudan University, completed her PhD at the University of Western Australia, and earned her undergraduate degree at Zhejiang University. Outside of work, Shilu enjoys birding, drawing, swimming, and fishkeeping. Contact: shiluzheng@xmu.edu.cn
